_help: What she says while she works the left panel to request docking. Docking_Start is the first thing (as she opens the panel), Docking_Contacts when she has found the Contacts tab, Docking_Retry when the cursor slipped and she has to go again. After the request goes through the game's own DockingRequested / DockingGranted lines take over, so none of these say 'granted'.
Docking_Start: Right, let's get you a pad.
Panel's coming up. Hands off the keys, please.
Let me get the contacts open.
Pad request. Give me a few seconds.
Docking_Contacts: Found the contacts. Looking for the station.
Station's on the list. One more step.
Got the contacts up. Don't touch anything.
Docking_Retry: Cursor wandered off. Back to the button.
